Since the variation $\boldsymbol\eta$ is meant to be arbitrary, it requires
\[\frac{\mathrm d}{\mathrm dt}\frac{\partial L}{\partial\dot{\boldsymbol q}}(\boldsymbol q(t),\dot{\boldsymbol q}(t))=\frac{\partial L}{\partial\boldsymbol q}(\boldsymbol q(t),\dot{\boldsymbol q}(t)),\]
which is precisely the Lagrangian formulation of the equations of motion.

context_notation: PDF82／印刷60，§2.2.1：$L(\boldsymbol q,\boldsymbol v)=\boldsymbol v^T M\boldsymbol v/2-U(\boldsymbol q)$；$M$ 为质量矩阵，$U$ 在此取 $C^2$。原条选定的运动方程使用这个拉格朗日函数及其位置、速度偏导数。

PDF82／印刷60：$\boldsymbol q(t)$ 是构型空间曲线的参数化，$t\in[\alpha,\beta]$，$\boldsymbol q(\alpha)=\boldsymbol Q$、$\boldsymbol q(\beta)=\boldsymbol Q^{\prime}$；$\dot{\boldsymbol q}$ 是时间导数。该页先说 twice continuously differentiable，随后又说各分量 $C^\infty$ 及 smooth，保留这两处原文，不将其静默统一。

PDF83／印刷61，式(2.3)：$\boldsymbol q^\epsilon(t)=\boldsymbol q(t)+\epsilon\boldsymbol\eta(t)$；$\boldsymbol\eta$ 为 $C^\infty$ 曲线，$\boldsymbol\eta(\alpha)=\boldsymbol\eta(\beta)=0$。arbitrary 指满足这些资格的任意变分方向。

PDF82–84／印刷60–62：$\mathcal A_L(\Gamma)=\int_\alpha^\beta L(\boldsymbol q(t),\dot{\boldsymbol q}(t))\,dt$。本句承接 Hamilton 原理要求一阶变分为零，以及 PDF84 上方分部积分后的 $\int_\alpha^\beta [\partial L/\partial\boldsymbol q-(d/dt)(\partial L/\partial\dot{\boldsymbol q})]\boldsymbol\eta(t)\,dt=0$。

Define the variational derivative of a functional $\mathcal F$, $\delta\mathcal F/\delta\boldsymbol q$ so that
\[\mathcal F(\boldsymbol q+\epsilon\boldsymbol\eta)=\epsilon\frac{\delta\mathcal F}{\delta\boldsymbol q}\boldsymbol\eta+O(\epsilon^2),\]
for all suitable (say, $C^\infty$) functions $\boldsymbol\eta$.
